beats.summary: Creed reveals he faked his own death for tax reasons and has been collecting benefits as his own widow.

evidence.snippet: Creed: About 10 years ago, for tax reasons, I faked my own death. I've been collecting benefits as my own widow ever since.

beats.summary: Andy confesses to Jim that he loves a woman he met and asks for help to talk to her despite Jim's reluctance.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Look, okay, just be my wingman. Beer me five minutes. Talk to Denise.

beats.summary: Michael attempts to apologize to a dissatisfied client, Barbara, but she remains furious despite his repeated apologies.
Angela refuses to apologize for the company's actions, leading to a heated argument with Kelly and ultimately quitting her job.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I'm not gonna lie and say I'm sorry when the company didn't do anything wrong.
Kelly: Well, you're fired, okay? Go back to accounting, Angela.

beats.summary: Jim and Denise have a casual conversation about high school and life in their town while Andy nervously prepares to talk to Jamie.

evidence.snippet: Jim (sits down next to Denise): So, high school.
Denise: There's nothing to do in this town.

beats.summary: Dwight and Creed discuss holding someone accountable for a company issue despite a call from Debbie Brown claiming innocence.

evidence.snippet: Creed: No time. Dwight, I love Debbie Brown. She's a close personal friend. But quality is my life.
